title: British Pound trades higher at start of UK data-packed, BoE policy week
summary: The British Pound (GBP) is up against its major currency peers, except North American currencies, at the start of the United Kingdom (UK) data-packed week and the Bank of England’s (BoE) monetary policy announcement.

title: WTI Price Forecast: Retains bullish bias above mid-$98.00s and 61.8% Fibo.
summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – kicks off the new week on a positive note, reversing a part of Friday's retracement slide from its highest level since May 21.

title: Brent Hits $108 as Saudi Pipeline Shutdown Deepens Supply Fears
summary: Brent crude hit $108 per barrel earlier today, following the latest escalation in the Middle East, before retreating to $107.22 per barrel at the time of writing. West Texas Intermediate was trading at $102.66 per barrel. The surge follows the news of a drone attack on Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline that could cut off another 4% of global oil supply and signs that efforts at diplomacy are failing.
